title: yapfast-plugin.json
description: A Yapfast plugin's manifest. Written for `yapfast-plugin.json` in a plugin's folder; an editor that validates against this turns a field the parser would refuse into a red squiggle while it is typed.
$comment: The manifest is read by two parsers in the tree, and this schema describes the union of what they accept, strict where either of them refuses. (1) `yapfast_plugin_api::PluginManifest::parse` (crates/yapfast-plugin-api/src/manifest.rs) is what an install reads: it is `#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]` all the way down, and it bounds `limits`, menu rows, buttons, `ui` changes, commands and the paths. (2) `yapfast_core::plugins::Manifest::parse` (crates/yapfast-core/src/plugins.rs) is what a folder is read with: its top level skips fields it doesn't name, but `menus`, `rail_items`, `header_buttons` and `ui` are the API crate's own structs, so they are denied unknown fields there too. `settings` is `yapfast_core::plugins::settings::RawSetting` (crates/yapfast-core/src/plugins/settings.rs), which is the shape the repository's manifests are written in; `SettingDecl` in the API crate is narrower and the two disagree today (see schemas/README.md). Checks that JSON Schema cannot express, and which this file therefore leaves to the parser: an id that `dependencies` also names (`DependsOnItself`), two settings sharing a key, a `when` that names a setting not declared before it, `min` above `max`, a slider with more than 1000 steps, a select with two options of one value, `local-port` without `network.local`, `on_failure: "block"` without `messages.intercept`, a plugin with no `wasm` and nothing to do, and colour/size names the interface this build does not have.

$schema.description: The schema this file was written against, so an editor finds it: `../../schemas/yapfast-plugin.schema.json` when the plugin sits in this repository, or the raw URL of the same file. Yapfast itself ignores it.

api.description: The guest ABI and interface version the plugin was built for. A manifest for another version is refused, so this is the only value `PluginManifest::problems` accepts (`UnsupportedApi`).

name.description: The display name, one line of 1 to 64 characters.

source.description: Where the source that was reviewed lives.

wasm.description: The WebAssembly module, relative to the manifest. Absent for a plugin that only sets named points or changes the interface.

tweaks.description: Named behaviours the plugin switches, by name.

pluginId.description: Reverse-DNS, lowercase, stable forever, as in `com.example.word-filter`. Matches `PluginId::parse`: at most 128 bytes, at least two dot-separated labels, each 1 to 63 bytes of `a-z`, `0-9` and `-`, and no label starting or ending with a hyphen.

version.description: `major`, `major.minor` or `major.minor.patch`, as `Version::from_str` reads one. A `-prerelease` or `+build` suffix may follow and is compared only by the numbers, so `1.4.0-beta.2` reads as `1.4.0`. Each number is a `u64`, so the pattern caps it at 20 digits; the handful of 20-digit numbers above 18446744073709551615 are the one thing it lets through that the parser refuses.

versionReq.description: A dependency requirement: `*`, or `^1.2`, `~1.4.0`, `=1.4.0` or a bare `1.4.0`, which means `^1.4.0`. As `VersionReq::from_str` reads one.

plainId.description: An action's or a row's id, as `plain_id` reads one: letters, digits, `-`, `_` and `.`, 1 to 64 bytes.

label.description: A label as the interface can draw it, as `plain_label` reads one: 1 to 64 characters, nothing blank and no control character.

relativePath.description: A path inside the plugin's folder: relative, and with no `..` component, as `check_relative_path` refuses one that leaves.

onFailure.description: What a hook does when the plugin fails or runs late. `block` needs the `messages.intercept` capability, which this schema cannot say.

limits.description: The memory and quota limits a manifest may raise. Every field has a default, so none is required.

memory_pages.description: Pages of guest memory, 64 KiB each: `limits::MIN_MEMORY_PAGES` to `limits::MAX_MEMORY_PAGES`. Defaults to 256.

http_response_bytes.description: An HTTP response's cap, in bytes, at most `limits::MAX_HTTP_RESPONSE_CONSENTED_BYTES` (16 MiB). Defaults to 4 MiB.

storage_bytes.description: The plugin's storage, in bytes, at most `limits::MAX_STORAGE_BYTES` (16 MiB). Defaults to 1 MiB.

items.description: A trigger: `command`, `menu`, `startup`, `event:<name>`, `decorate`, `identity`, `code` or `member.decorate`. Anything else activates nothing rather than being refused.

permissions.description: `Permissions` renames its fields to kebab-case, so `local_port` is written `local-port`.

local-port.description: The one loopback port `network.local` opens. Naming it without that capability is refused, which this schema cannot say.

capability.description: Every name `Capability` has. `files.save` and `microphone` are read and then dropped rather than refused, because nothing in this build checks them.

hostPattern.description: A host the plugin may reach: `api.example.com`, or `*.cdn.example.com` for one level below it. As `HostPattern::parse` reads one; a bare `*` is refused.

dependencyMap.description: Plugins by id, each with the version the manifest requires.

name.description: The word after `/`. An empty one refuses the manifest.

description.description: Shown beside the command. Written but empty refuses the manifest.

choices.description: The values a `choice` option admits; empty for every other kind.

action.description: The action the plugin receives when the row is chosen.

menuTarget.description: What a menu row or a `ui` row is about. A closed list: a name outside it refuses the manifest.

whenClause.description: The closed set of conditions a menu row or a `ui` row may carry. Each field given must match, and each left out always does.

uiDecl.description: What a plugin changes in the interface Yapfast already draws. A row, a part, a colour and a size each count one against `CHANGES` (64); this schema caps each list and map at 64 and cannot express the sum.

additionalProperties.description: A colour as `#rgb`, `#rrggbb` or `#rrggbbaa`. A name this build has not got, or a value that isn't a colour, is refused on the plugin's page rather than in the manifest.
Logical pixels, clamped to the range the size has. A name this build has not got is refused on the plugin's page.

row.description: The built-in row's id, as the interface names it, such as `copy-id`.

settingKey.description: 1 to 64 bytes: lowercase letters, digits and `_`, starting with a letter.

setting.description: One setting the plugin's page draws. The fields beyond `key`, `type`, `label`, `description`, `when` and `default` are the ones its `type` allows, as `allowed()` reads them.

default.description: The value the setting starts with. Whether it suits the setting's own rules is checked by the parser, which this schema cannot express.

pattern.description: A regular expression the whole value must match. That it compiles is checked by the parser.

settingField.description: One field of a list's record: `bool`, `string`, `select`, `number` or `integer`. It has no `description`, no `when`, and it cannot be a `slider`, a `list` or a `widget`.

selectOption.description: One option of a select: a bare value, which is also its label, or a value with a label.

settingTests.description: One test, or 1 to 8 of them, all of which must hold.

settingTest.description: A test on a setting declared before this one. That the named setting exists, and that the value suits it, is checked by the parser.
